denied.title: Restricted access
denied.hint: The client file is reserved for salon accounts. Ask your administrator for access.

search.label: Search for a client
search.hintAll: Name, phone or email — the file holds {count, plural, one {# record} other {# records}}.
search.hintTerm: Name, phone or email — {count, plural, one {# record} other {# records}} for “{term}”.
search.tooShort: Searching needs at least {min} characters — a single letter would return the whole file.
search.tooLong: Search stops at {max} characters — beyond that, no record can match.

pageEmpty.title: This page is empty
pageEmpty.description: The file holds {count, plural, one {# record} other {# records}}, but none on this page. <link>Back to the first page</link>.

empty.title: No client records yet
empty.descriptionAll: The file fills up with the first booking, or from <link>the calendar</link> — booking at the front desk creates the record along the way.
empty.descriptionTerm: Search matches the start of a name, phone number or email address. Try the first letters only, or create the record from <link>the calendar</link>.

missing.title: Record not found
missing.body: No record in this salon carries that identifier. Look the person up by name, phone or email in the left-hand pane.

empty.title: No record open
empty.description: Pick someone from the file to see their contact details, internal note and visit history.

suppression.title: Email address suppressed — nothing is sent any more
suppression.body: No confirmation, reminder or cancellation notice goes to {email}. Reach the client another way — by phone or at the front desk. The address cannot be corrected from here: the back office does not change it, since it cannot verify a new one.

reasons.hard_bounce: hard bounce — the mailbox does not exist or refuses our messages
reasons.complaint: complaint — the message was reported as spam

noShow.title: {count, plural, one {# no-show} other {# no-shows}}
noShow.body: Worth weighing before granting a peak-time slot.

summary.counts: {count, plural, one {# appointment in total} other {# appointments in total}} · first visit on {first} · latest on {last}.
summary.caption: The counters cover every appointment; “Total completed” only adds up completed visits, and shows “—” while there are none or when the record mixes several currencies.

history.title: Visit history
history.emptyDescription: The history fills up as soon as a first appointment is booked — completed, cancelled or missed.
history.staffRemoved: practitioner no longer at the salon
history.truncated: The {shown} most recent visits are shown; the counters above cover all {total} appointments.

contact.savedBody: Upcoming confirmations will go to these details.
contact.phoneHint: Leave empty to remove the number — the day-before reminder will then go by email only.
contact.emailHint: The record’s identifier in this salon. The MVP cannot verify a new address yet: it is not editable here.

errors.tooLong: this field is {max} characters at most

note.title: Internal note
note.savedBody: Only salon staff can see it.
note.label: What the salon should know
note.hint: Preferences, allergies, sensitivities. Never sent to the client — not by email, not by SMS. Saving replaces the previous note; clearing the field deletes it.
